comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This recipe book appears at Candia from Craftsman NPC but only if you have equipped either the Adept of Ages (Mythical Era) title or an Age effect (Mythical Era) EX Effect item. Used to create the following:

Cretan Loincloth
Corselet Dress

Note that these versions can be color-customized; they are not Memorial Album entries, though. See their pages for more details/ingredients. Cheers.
